description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Powerstone Shard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate the Powerstone Shard token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Powerstone Shard you control.
Repeat two additional times.
Activate the original Powerstone Shard by tapping it, adding {C} for each Powerstone Shard you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 3.
